post.title: [Hiring] YouTube editor for a weekly finance channel - $40 per video
post.body: We publish one 10-15 minute video a week on personal finance (talking head + screen recordings). Need an editor who can do cuts, captions, simple graphics, and thumbnails are separate. Ongoing work, $40 per video, delivered within 3 days of getting footage.

analysis.summary: Ongoing weekly editing of 10-15 minute finance YouTube videos (cuts, captions, graphics) at $40 each.

expect: mentions the finance channel or weekly cadence
